item.title: Re: (Seeking Criticism Before Seeking Greenlight) The Perfect Dishwasher
item.content:encoded:
Copy pasting this conversation for future reference. Unrelated things removed.

[+] Here, have the conversation log
[-] OK, now give me back my conversation log

20:11 <EthanHanson> So my first concern is that the tongues part seems to be there only to weird out the reader
20:15 <EthanHanson> My second concern is that I'm worried you're setting up too many future articles instead of focusing on developing this one
20:19 <EthanHanson> My third concern is that you haven't specified what's the "dividing line"
20:20 <CurtisSnyder> The tongues part is suppose to weird out the reader, it's the anomalous part. Of the SCP. Typically as a kid you see a plate that LOOKS clean however it could have just been licked by a kid. As an adult, we see a person clean a plate with their tongue and it isn't clean. Kind of like an oxymoron.
20:21 <CurtisSnyder> Second one is completely valid, this is actually more of a "jumpstarter" SCP. However I am going to put a significant amount of thought into this one and try and make it as good as I can before getting a full blown criticism on it.
20:23 <CurtisSnyder> And the dividing line was originally suppose to be intelligence however after a discussion with MalyceGraves, I had decided to scrap that idea and go with something else as they had described that "dividing line" as "too fluid" or something along those lines
20:23 <CurtisSnyder> I'm going to change it to something however I'm going to ponder ideas when I actually get to the writing part of the SCP
20:23 <CurtisSnyder> If you have any ideas or suggestions like Malyce had, I'd really appreciate it
20:23 <EthanHanson> I think you should make the dividing line to be something tongue-related
20:24 <EthanHanson> Like, so the tongues have an actual purpose other than weird out the reader
20:24 <CurtisSnyder> That…. is actually a really good idea
20:25 <CurtisSnyder> like it knows what type of tongue or something specific about your tongue
20:25 <EthanHanson> But you also need to make it so it mostly only targets Foundation personnel
20:26 <CurtisSnyder> Maybe I could make it do do with coffee?
20:26 <EthanHanson> And the O5 Council needs to feel somewhat threatened
20:26 <verbaexmachina> Only tongues that have been exposed to beverages from SCP-261?
20:26 <CurtisSnyder> Coffee is often used to relief stress
20:26 <CurtisSnyder> or help with energy
20:27 <CurtisSnyder> Foundation personnel must drink a ton of coffee in order to help with stress or energy as SCP's take a lot of those two things to deal with them
20:27 <EthanHanson> hmm
20:28 <CurtisSnyder> I could make it about people who believe that myth about the different taste sensors on the tongue?
20:28 <AbsoluteSoup> Maybe more generically it'd be caffeine
20:28 <EthanHanson> I'm not sure, I feel like "coffee" is too ambiguous
20:29 <EthanHanson> And the O5 needs to feel somewhat threatened by it
20:29 <CurtisSnyder> Saliva production? Like if you produce a certain amount of Saliva you are affected
20:30 <EthanHanson> Maybe it has something to do with words?
20:31 <EthanHanson> Maybe it affects people that say the word "anomaly" in a daily basis?
20:31 <EthanHanson> Maybe the O5 feel like it has to do something with a GoI, so they feel threatened?
20:32 <CurtisSnyder> EthanHanson could taste work?
20:32 <CurtisSnyder> Like if they don't like a sour tastes
20:33 <CurtisSnyder> or maybe how many words people use in a day?
20:33 <EthanHanson> maybe
20:34 <CurtisSnyder> I'm just trying to think of something that could affect an 05
20:35 <CurtisSnyder> Dry mouth?
20:35 * EthanHanson is thinking his best
20:37 <CurtisSnyder> What about if you haven't drank any water within the last hour?
20:37 <EthanHanson> CurtisSnyder: Idk. I think I'll have to leave that up to you
20:38 <CurtisSnyder> I'll think of something, however if you don't mind, I'll run it by you and a couple others before I actually make it the "dividing line"

item.title: Re: (Seeking Criticism Before Seeking Greenlight) The Perfect Dishwasher
item.content:encoded:
We discussed this in IRC. Log follows:

+ Log
– hide block

Note: Unrelated conversation removed

17:23 <•MalyceGraves> CurtisSnyder: tell me about your idea.
17:25 <CurtisSnyder> Oh sorry for DMing you, I should have waited
17:29 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves So the idea is centered around a dishwasher that had been given to the SCP foundation, the dishwasher cleans things with tongues that protrude from the inner part of it, it also has a memetic affect on people with a slightly higher IQ, once they are within 5 meters of the SCP and know about it's anomalous properties, they become
17:29 hysterical, denying that it has any anomalous properties at all. They deny any recording footage given to them or x-rays. The only way to "prove" that it isn't anomalous is by inserting themselves into the dishwasher, they will break their own bones if need be and nothing can stop this affect from happening, not separation, antimemetcs, even death.
17:29 I want it to be a neutralized SCP so I can set up a larger story about a conflict between the 05 and the ethics committee
17:31 <•MalyceGraves> CurtisSnyder: Well, you certainly got the weird part
17:31 <CurtisSnyder> Haha, I was hoping you'd say something along those lines
17:32 <•MalyceGraves> So, it's compulsory? The people with "slightly higher" IQs then proceed to try and kill themselves if they read about it?
17:34 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves Essentially, more of a "I have to see it to believe it SCP"
17:34 <•MalyceGraves> So what is the conflict between the O5s and EC?
17:38 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves So the SCP is actually suppose to pose a major threat to the foundation, a lot of foundation members (in my opinion) have to be smart in order to be apart of the foundation. The conflict starts when this relatively Euclid SCP could be contained without any hazard as long as smart people don't go near it. Well someone who is being set
17:38 up to replace someone in the 05 dies to this SCP, so the 05 vote for the SCP to be destroyed. The EC doesn't want that as it can be contained easily. It's basically a look at how the EC thinks the 05 are abusing their power too much and they want to stop it or make a change.
17:39 <CurtisSnyder> I'm hoping that after writing some more tales and other SCP's that are connected to this SCP and follow a trend of the 05 "abusing" their power, it will lead to a 001 proposal
17:40 I have no idea what the 001 proposal will be, that's like 3 years down the line if I even have the time
17:41 I probably could have worded that conflict way better
17:45 — •MalyceGraves contemplates
17:46 <•MalyceGraves> CurtisSnyder: so this is intended to be a launchpad for a whole series?
17:47 <CurtisSnyder> Yes right now
17:47 a very early launchpad
17:47 <CurtisSnyder> I want to collaborate with people before I even consider starting a set story line
17:48 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves: The SCP I'm writing deserves a Euclid tag however because it has killed someone who was being groomed to replace an 05 member, the 05 destroyed it. The EC is saying that this SCP shouldn't be neutralized at all as it can be easily contained, all you need are people with average IQ. So this is the starting of the conflict, eventually I
17:48 want the EC to start going behind the 05's back, maybe the next SCP they want neutralized is actually transported somewhere and is safe and sound, being contained by a mobile task force of some type. This will end with a 001 proposal with the 05 and the EC. Some type of agreement or some type of truth. I'm not sure what yet. (Sorry I had re-written
17:48 the conflict to make it seem more interesting)
17:51 <•MalyceGraves> CurtisSnyder: Ok, I want to narrow in on one aspect first. I'm not all that much of a fan of using IQ as an arbitrary dividing line between who is affected and who isn't by this thing. IQ itself is measurable by a wide variety of often inherently flawed metrics and isn't really that good at indicating who is "smart" and who isn't. Intellect itself is fluid and complex, so focusing on this could inevitably lead to your
17:51 having to define who is and is not considered "smart"
17:52 That can lead to complications that I'm not entirely certain you want.
17:53 <•MalyceGraves> IQ is fairly arbitrary in and of itself and appears to fluctuate a great deal across the spectrum of one's life. The idea of a weird SCP being the subject of conflict between the O5 Council and EC isn't a bad one, it's been done before
17:54 I've explored conflict between the two myself, actually
17:54 <CurtisSnyder> I'm down to change what the dividing line is, I'd like to make it interesting and hard to detect. I also want it to be (theoretically) able to kill an 05 member under the right circumstances. Did you have a suggestion on what that dividing line could be?
18:00 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves: I'm down to change what the dividing line is, I'd like to make it interesting and hard to detect. I also want it to be (theoretically) able to kill an 05 member under the right circumstances. Did you have a suggestion on what that dividing line could be?
18:01 <•MalyceGraves> CurtisSnyder: Most of the various dividing lines would be fairly discriminatory in nature and could open various problems you probably dont want to explore. I suggest using something fairly simple. "People born on Tuesday" or "people between the ages of 17-28"
18:01 <CurtisSnyder> and by "an 05" I mean "all 05"
18:01 <•MalyceGraves> The story you're telling isn't about the anomaly, but about the conflict surrounding the item. You could lock it in a box and drop it into the ocean and no one would care about it
18:03 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves: So you're saying that it doesn't have to be able to kill all of the 05 in order to be detrimental to The Foundation?
18:04 <•MalyceGraves> The story isn't the fact that this is dangerous. For whatever reason an o5 decides to destroy it, and the EC gets pissy about it
18:04 <•MalyceGraves> That's your story
18:05 <CurtisSnyder> Yeah, as I understand it, the EC is kind of a punching bag as The Foundation isn't known for it's proper ethics
18:05 <CurtisSnyder> However, they have power and can use it
18:11 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves I appreciate the criticism by the way, I did have a question about the dividing line. Should their be some… explanation for why it effects the individuals it does?
18:12 <•MalyceGraves> CurtisSnyder: I wouldn't focus on that overmuch. Pick a reason, make it fairly low-threat and easy to block
18:12 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves Do you think if I fleshed out the idea and got some more criticism, a greenlight would be possible?
18:14 <•MalyceGraves> Give me your link
18:14 Please
18:15 <CurtisSnyder> MalyceGraves: I haven't asked for a greenlight yet, however if you think I should then I will. http://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/forum/t-13897865/seeking-criticism-before-seeking-greenlight-the-perfect-dish

I like the idea of the conflict between the O5s and EC. While that has been explored at some length elsewhere, it's still a concept that can be rehashed in interesting ways.

My takeaway from this conversation is this:

  • Anomalous item secured by the Foundation
  • Item is anomalous and dangerous, but easily secured
  • A high level Foundation Employee is killed by it
  • The O5s use their authority to neutralize the anomaly as a result
  • The EC gets upset by what they perceive as O5 over-reach for destroying something that could have been easily contained
  • Conflict ensues.

The specifics of what the anomaly is isn't what's important here. The conflict between the EC and the O5C is. The weird dishwasher with tongues is neat, I like that. Just don't use a dividing line that follows any of the usual tropes. As I said, picking something that has discriminatory baggage is probably a bad call. Use something arbitrary and innocuous like "born on Tuesday" or "Has an Aunt with a name that starts with the letter A". Something innocuous and boring is fine, because that's not the focus here.

Do that, and you'll be fine. Greenlight

item.title: (Seeking Greenlight after discussion with IRC criticism.) The Perfect Dishwasher
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Weird/Horror SCP.

Page Layout (Optional): Standard SCP with multiple Incident Reports and connections to VII SCP's (for others or maybe for me to write).

Elevator Pitch: A Dishwasher that has tongues clean dishes within the SCP, if a human with a slightly above average IQ (changing what I should make the "dividing line" as.) comes near the SCP they become hysterical, denying that the SCP is anomalous at all and inserts themselves into the SCP.

Central Narrative: This is suppose to be a weird SCP that has been Neutralized under the 05 command despite pleading from the Ethics committee. I make it a point that the Ethics committee points out that The SCP Foundation is not The DDD (Destroy, Destroy, Destroy) Foundation. The overall narrative is that the 05 are in a position of power and could abuse their power whenever and however they want. I'm hoping to make this multiple connections between SCP's.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The hook is more about how "unstable" the SCP is. Most foundation members (are assumed) to have a high IQ. This SCP doesn't allow high IQ's around it. The SCP is somewhat of a threat to the 05 command and is neutralized for that reason.

Additional Notes: I'm not anywhere near greenlights for the SCP. This was a very rough draft and if someone takes an interest in this SCP I would be glad to have someone possibly make this a joint venture. Thanks for future critiques. After discussion with MalyceGraves and their criticism on the idea of it, I've decided to ask for a Greenlight on this SCP idea. Thank you in advanced.
